scientific_integrity: Infinite assertions are proved using the five-step recurrence and an integral restricted-series block-sum lemma. Finite exact-checker assertions supplement rather than replace that proof; literature searches do not certify novelty.
scientific_limitations: The image and fiber theorem concerns the Morita five-adic gamma function at p=5, not arbitrary primes, and the full 1975 original text and the general p-adic analysis textbook were not obtained for a complete historical-priority comparison. An earlier equivalent or implicit specialization may exist.
title: The complete five-adic image and exact fibers of Morita's gamma function
